summary: The root خَبَأ primarily means to hide or conceal something, making it unseen or unknown. It can also refer to something that is stored away or kept secret.

parts.t: He expressed a thing enigmatically to him, and then asked him respecting it.

headwords.def: اختبأ It was, or became, hidden, or concealed: (Mgh:) he hid, or concealed, himself. (S.) It is also trans.: see 1. [Hence,] اختبأ لَهُ He expressed a thing enigmatically to him, and then asked him respecting it. (IDrd, K. [See also 3.])

headwords.def: خَبْءٌ خبء (S, Msb, K) and (TA) and , of the measure فُعْلَةٌ from الخبأ [or rather الخَبْءُ ], like غُرْفَةٌ and قُبْضَةٌ from الغَرْفُ and القَبْضُ , (Har p. 426,) and (S, K) and , (K,) of which last the pl. is خَبَايَا , (TA,) A thing that is hidden, or concealed, (S, * Msb, K,) and absent, or unseen. (K.) [Hence,] خَبْءُ السَّمَآءِ The rain. (Th, S, K.) And خَبْءُ الأَرْضِ The plants, or herbage. (S, K.) And الأَرْضِ The seed which the sower has hidden in the earth: or what God has hidden in the mines of the earth. (TA, from a trad.) الَّذِى يُخْرِجُ الخَبْءَ فِى السَّمٰوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ , in the Kur [xxvii. 25], is held by Az to mean Who knoweth what is unseen in the heavens and the earth; agreeably with an explanation of الخَبْءُ by Fr. (TA.)
خِبْءٌ خبء : see the next preceding paragraph.

headwords.def: خَبْأَةٌ A daughter; syn. بِنْتٌ . (K, TA. [In the CK, النَّبْتُ is put for البِنْتُ .]) Hence the prov., خَبْأَةٌ خَيْرٌ مِنْ يَفَعَةِ سَوْءٍ [ A daughter is better than a grown-up boy of evil deeds ]. (TA.) [In Freytag's Arab. Prov., i. 438, the first word in this prov. is written خُبَأَة , and followed by صِدْقٍ .] Aboo-Zeyd Sa'eed Ibn-Ows El-Ansáree entitled one of his books كتاب خبأة because he commenced it by mentioning خبأة in the sense of بنت , quoting the foregoing prov. in confirmation thereof. (TA.)

headwords.def: خِبَآءٌ خبآء A well-known kind of structure; (K;) [i. e.] a kind of tent, (Mgh, TA,) made of wool, (Mgh, Msb,) or of camels' fur, or sometimes of [ goats' ] hair, sometimes upon two poles, or three; what is above this kind being termed بَيْتٌ : (Msb:) or a tent having one pole; that which has more than one pole being termed بيت : (AZ, TA in art. ربع :) [or] also applied to a بيت [or tent ] of any kind: (Towsheeh, TA voce بَيْتٌ , q. v.:) pl. أَخْبِئَةٌ , (TA,) or أَخْبِيَةٌ : (Msb:) it is from خَبَأَهُ “ he hid it, ” or “ concealed it: ” (Mgh:) or it belongs to art. خبى : (K:) most of the lexicologists hold that its radical letters are خبى : some, that they are خبو : IDrd asserts that they are خبأ . (TA:) [See also art. خبى .] A mark made with a hot iron upon some secret part of an excellent she-camel:
خَبِىْءٌ خبىء خبيء خبئ : see خَبْءٌ : and see also 8.
خَبِيْئَةٌ , and its pl. خَبَايَا : see خَبٌءٌ , in two places.

headwords.gloss: A place; chamber, for hiding; concealing
headwords.def: مَخْبَأٌ A place, or chamber, for hiding or concealing [ anything ]; a secret place or chamber: pl. مَخَابِئُ . (MA.)
